releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.1 is a tray stability hotfix. Tray 1.0.0.6 adds a WinForms Resize reentrancy guard to prevent nested minimise-to-tray window transitions from recursively re-entering Resize and terminating in USER32.dll with STATUS_STACK_OVERFLOW (0xc00000fd). Service remains 0.2.5.0. Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 remains included in the DEV artifact with cache-busted manifest support.
